Capacity score measures modeled coverage of the actual offered monthly payments. A zero offered loan has score zero. It is not default probability or an automatic credit decision.

data_provenance: All history, forecast distributions, expenses and future surplus in this report are explicitly synthetic test fixtures. No real borrower repayment/default or forecast accuracy claim.
future_labels_boundary: Separate disclosed synthetic outcome arrays were supplied only to compare_actual_surplus after assess_request had completed; scorer received history and frozen point/quantile forecasts only.

metrics_definition.capacity_score: Revenue-grid fraction covering actual offered payments conditional on observed cost projection; no real borrower probability.
metrics_definition.interest_total_full_term: Sum of actual schedule payments minus identical offered principal; 24% nominal rate applied to changing outstanding balance.
metrics_definition.overload_months: Actual supplied future surplus is more than 1 UZS below that schedule monthly payment.
metrics_definition.overload_volume: Sum max(payment - actual future surplus,0), UZS; includes sub-1 UZS differences.

purpose: Behavioral validation of actual offered seasonal vs fixed annuity schedules at identical principal, 24% annual nominal interest and 12-month term. Descriptive overload against separate fixture future surplus.
